name: breadcrumb
description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
purpose: Shows where a page sits in the site hierarchy so people can step back to a parent section without the main nav.
bestFor: admin screens with a parent list
avoidFor: single-level pages with no parent trail
